reusable_explanation: E2156 applies to CMake and CTest harnesses that must run BLACS or similar MPI test ELFs from their original RUNPATH location, preserve empty list arguments, and flush a completion marker before intentional MPI_Abort. E2155 applies to Conan libraries that intentionally publish no public headers and therefore must clear the default include usage requirement while still validating a real generated imported target consumer. The existing Fortran MPI provider ABI gate is reused for provider identity and ABI checks.
